goal: Operationally characterize Goose CLI as a candidate executor for Apex parallel delegated tasks.
scope: Goose CLI 1.49.0 executable and configured provider path
concurrency, identity, aggregation, failure, retry, cancellation, dependencies, and per-subtask model/provider observations
evidence report and control-plane suitability classification
out_of_scope: Goose ownership of backlog, scheduling, authority, or verification
architecture_constraints: executors remain workers and never canonical backlog or scheduler authority
Apex Core remains authority and verification owner
no secrets in evidence, logs, backlog, or Passport
docs and runtime observations must distinguish PROVEN from PROMPT-SEMANTIC and NOT_PROVEN
acceptance_criteria: parent delegation to multiple independent subtasks is executed
true concurrent execution is directly evidenced or classified conservatively
distinct delegated identity is observed where available
result aggregation is observed or classified
one controlled subtask failure leaves unrelated work classified independently
retry or rework behavior is tested or classified
individual cancellation is tested or classified
dependency sequencing is tested or classified
per-subtask model/provider assignment is tested or classified
executor suitability for Apex Control Plane integration is classified
validation: machine-readable or timestamped observations where available
canonical Python tests and documentation validation
